{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check how many unique patients there are vs. total rows
print(f'Total rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Unique patient_id: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check which patient_ids are duplicated
duplicated_ids = df[df.duplicated(subset="patient_id", keep=False)]["patient_id"].unique()
print(f'Duplicated patient_ids: {duplicated_ids}')

# Check sample_seq values for duplicates
print('\nSample_seq for duplicated patients:')
df[df["patient_id"].isin(duplicated_ids)].sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"])"}
